Our prediction came true, and we're now seeing 2026.2.9.9 (FSD V14.3.2) approaching ~15% saturation within the first 24 hours, after three separate waves!

Two waves yesterday, and one at approximately 4AM (PST). We anticipate more waves within the next 24 hours.


Teslascope (@teslascope)

Very solid chance of that or this update finally being the one to break past 1%!

A week from now, on April 28th at 2 AM (PST), our service will go offline for a brief maintenance to upgrade our databases.

Vehicle polling will be momentarily disrupted, and we expect the downtime to conclude in under fifteen minutes.

Thank you for your understanding.
